caseName: Rose v. Kansas ex rel. Coleman
caseNameFull: W. W. Rose, in Error v. The State of Kansas on the Relation of C. C. Coleman, Attorney General
attorneys: Mr. Frederic D. McKenney for plaintiff in error. Mr. C. C. Coleman for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas.

Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Smiley v. Kansas, 196 U. S. 447; Nonconnah Turnpike Company v. Tennessee, 131 U. S. App. Cl. VIII; Newport Light Company v. Newport, 151 U. S. 527; Harrison v. Morton, 171 U. S. 38.
